title: Zerovision Ore Emissive Addon
description:
Glowing ores and copper ore reskin for Zerovision resource pack!
Old copper texture was kept in files so you can remove _old suffix to enable it.
body:
Glowing ores and copper ore reskin for [Zerovision](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/zerovision) resource pack!
Old copper texture was kept in files so you can remove _old suffix to enable it.
